trigger: PnP valid-pose flag false; optical-flow-only and lost frames both trigger
pre_context_reason: Fixed operational video buffer, declared before replay; not selected from manual event times
stop: PnP consecutive valid samples reach recovery_samples AND final stop_confirmation_samples of 6D median speed are all <= existing stop_deg_s
scope: Offline replay of recorded matrices only; selected unique frames are a workload count, NOT real hybrid latency or speedup
limitation: Only pose unavailability triggers selection; incorrect but marked-valid PnP is not caught. An active window may extend almost the whole clip.
